title: Kati chinde
text: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || Kati chinde kati jahe || kati vuttari bhāvaye || katisaṅgātigo bhikkhu || oghatiṇṇo ti viccatīti || || Pañca chinde pañca jahe || pañca vuttari bhāvaye || pañcasaṅgātigo bhikkhu || oghatiṇṇo ti vuccatīti || ||
